endpoint.recipe: ai/client.go fixed /aig/v1 with exact override support
endpoint.scope: caller-asserted account; no project or location inferred

request.mapping: explicit model/text messages; Chat stream=false; StreamChat stream=true/Accept text/event-stream; explicit positive per-event/total/event-count limits; no business defaults

response.completeness: bounded JSON, partial parameter surface; unknown Selectel-specific full response/deployment inventory
response.usage: exact Integer counters, optional usage; absent is not zero
response.refs: completion/model IDs remain protected metadata; no resource/task ref or wait
response.stream: typed protected ChatChunk callback, optional exact Usage, bounded retained prefix; Complete only at compiled [DONE]; EOF/malformed/limit/cancellation/consumer-error retains accepted receipt and incomplete summary

errors.mapping: core HTTP mapping; raw messages/body discarded; accepted malformed/body-limit error retains Receipt
errors.guardrail: 422 nested error.code=guardrail_rejected -> rejected receipt, provider_error with compiled ProviderCode; optional bounded diagnostic body never erased known HTTP rejection; x-gateway-request-id safe metadata
errors.consumer: incomplete with raw callback error discarded

retry: all model POST mutations: no automatic replay, no idempotency assumptions
